index.yes-cancel-more-than: Yes. Cancel more than 24 hours before the lesson, or within 30 minutes of paying, for a full refund. Later than that there's no refund, but you can propose a new time instead. Details are in the refund policy.

index.tutors-set-their-own: Tutors set their own rates, and you can propose your own price in your request. The minimum booking is €15. Group sessions split the cost between up to 4 students.
